messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] model-family=kestrel11b high TPM spike detected (3.6x baseline). latency p50 ↑, errors ↑. paging oncall.
maya: on it — grabbing current metrics and recent deploys.
sam: I see a correlated burst from a single customer token group. sending query to identify prefixes.
lin: customer impact? errors or latency?
maya: p50 ~1.8s (normal 0.3s), 5% 5xx across the family; tail latency and queueing visible on gpu pools. A few customers report throttling spikes.
sam: rolling per-family throttle now. proposal: reduce kestrel11b TPM from 1200 -> 300, set RPM soft cap to 1200. apply prefixed carveout for the offending customer to avoid total outage.
maya: agree. Also enable fallback routing to kestrel11b-q4 (quantized) for high-latency requests.
ops-bot: running command: `infra rate-adjust --family kestrel11b --tpm 300 --rpm 1200 --reason "emergency sculpting"`
deploy-bot: deploy accepted, applying rule to edge routers (change-id: r8f-449).
lin: @sam please confirm funcall/tool calling remains enabled or should we disable? customers using tool-calls are the highest latency.
sam: disable funcall for kestrel11b for now. command: `infra feature-toggle --family kestrel11b --feature funcall --state off`
maya: executed both changes. monitoring dashboards show incoming TPM dropping toward target. latency p50 improving (1.1s) but p95 still high.
ops-bot: alert: per-node queue depth falling.
maya: customer carveout applied: token-prefix tx-88* limited to 50 TPM. That customer accounted for ~40% of the burst.
sam: putting a temporary canary: allow small % traffic to kestrel11b at original capacity for trusted customers. config snippet: `{ allowlist: [acct-42], percent: 5 }`
lin: what's timeline to roll these back?
maya: will hold for 30m, reassess metrics and error rates. If stable, increment TPM in 2 steps (300->600 -> 900).
sam: filing a short incident note for engineering postmortem with root cause tags: traffic shaping, customer burst, model family.
maya: notifying CS for impacted customers and to surface any escalations. @lin can you own CS handoff?
lin: on it, DMing priority list.
maya: postmortem action items: add per-prefix auto-throttle detection, tighten default RPM floors, add a guard to auto-disable funcall on high-latency runs.
sam: ack.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] mitigation applied, thread 3789012345.
maya: Thanks team. continue to watch for 30m then hand back to SRE rotation. :thumbsup:
